title: NEMA 17 Planetary Gearbox, 5:1
one_line: A single-stage 5:1 planetary reducer for a NEMA 17 stepper: a 12T sun on the motor's 5 mm D-shaft, three 18T planets on needle bearings and a 48T ring, with the carrier's 8 mm output shaft running in two 608 bearings.
specs: Ratio 5:1 exactly (1 + 48/12); sun and output turn the same way
Module 1, 25 deg pressure angle; sun 12T, 3 x planet 18T, ring 48T internal; centre distance 15 mm
Involute flanks as polylines (8 segments a flank), 0.06 mm backlash per flank; about 0.11 mm minimum tooth gap in a 2D check
Housing 64 mm OD, 40.5 mm motor face to output cover; 98 mm overall with a 40 mm motor
Output shaft 8 mm with 0.5 mm D-flat, 17.5 mm long, on 2 x 608 (8 x 22 x 7) bearings
Planets on 4 mm pins with HK0408-envelope drawn-cup needle bearings and thrust washers
Motor interface: 22 mm pilot, 4 x M3 x 6 on the 31 mm pattern; sun clamped by an M3 set screw on the shaft's flat
Output mounting: 32 mm spigot, 4 x M3 tapped on 44 mm PCD; housing clamped by 6 x M3 x 25
parameters: out: output (carrier) angle, drives the carrier revolute
sun = out * 5: drives the motor shaft / sun revolute (derived)
planet = out * -8 / 3: planet spin relative to the carrier (derived)
interference: 109 pairs at out = 0 deg and 123 pairs at out = 36 deg, 0 interferences
poses: out = 0 deg: solve converged, 0 interferences (109 pairs)
out = 36 deg (sun 180 deg, planets -96 deg relative to the carrier): solve converged, 0 interferences (123 pairs); saved pose, rendered
not_verified: No gear mate in ryucad: the 5:1 and planet kinematics are imposed by parameter expressions, not solved from tooth contact
3D interference checked at two poses only; other angles checked in 2D on the tooth profiles
No torque, tooth strength, efficiency, mass or backlash tolerance analysis
Involutes are polylines without root fillets or tip relief; threads not modelled; motor is an envelope; bearing internals simplified
No axial retainer on the outer 608, no shaft seal, no set-screw access hole
